figures.finding: Aruba levies its own income tax: 0% to AWG 34,930, 21% to 63,904, 42% to 135,527 and 52% above, after a tax-free amount of AWG 30,000 for a full-year taxpayer, so no tax is due on taxable income up to AWG 64,930 in 2026.

sources.said: Individual income tax rate Taxable income (AWG) Rate Up to 34,930 0% 34,931–63,904 21% 63,905–135,527 42% Over 135,527 52%

A tax-free amount of AWG 30,000 applies to taxpayers that are qualified as payers of income tax for the entire calendar year. This effectively means that a taxpayer with annual taxable income not exceeding AWG 64,930 will not be subject to income tax for 2026.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the return is due within two months after the year end, extendable on request.

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year.
The tax return must be filed within two months after the year end. Upon request, an extension to file the tax return is possible.

figures.finding: Wage tax is withheld from employment income as a pre-levy of income tax.

sources.said: Wage tax is levied on the employment income of an individual and is a pre-levy of the individual income tax

figures.finding: The employer pays pay-related social insurance for employees, and employed and self-employed people pay capped social insurance contributions.
figures.applies: The 2026 AOV/AWW and AZV rates and caps were not found; see blocker.

figures.finding: A non-resident is taxed only on Aruba-source income; there is no withholding on royalties or service fees, and turnover tax on a foreign performer's cultural or entertainment services to an Aruban business is paid by the recipient.

sources.said: Basis: Residents are taxed on their worldwide income; nonresidents are taxed only on Aruba-source income.
Royalties: There is no withholding tax on royalties.

figures.finding: There is no VAT; turnover tax (BBO) of 7% falls on services, and anyone making taxable supplies in Aruba must register, with monthly returns.

sources.said: Rates: The standard turnover tax rate is 7%.
Registration: Residents and nonresidents that make taxable deliveries of goods or services in Aruba must register for turnover

figures.finding: Aruba's income tax law gives authors no special treatment: its text names no rule for authors' fees or royalties, which a resident counts with the rest of his income, and a non-resident is taxed only on the domestic income it lists, which names no royalties.
figures.applies: Landsverordening inkomstenbelasting (AB 1991 no. GT 51), arts. 3 and 17, as consolidated in the Centraal Wettenregister on 17 October 2023 (last amendment listed AB 2023 no. 25); its whole text carries no word 'royalty', 'auteur', 'artiest' or 'kunst' (read 2026-11-02).
